ko: 당신은 사랑 받기 위해 태어난 사람
당신의 삶 속에서 그 사랑 받고 있지요
en: You were created to receive the greatest love
you experience his love in every portion of your life
From the beginning, God has shown his love to bless you
As we greet and bless each other, there is fruit of love
Because you are with us we experience tremendous joy
Let us come before our God with thankgiving in our hearts.

ko: 당신은 사랑 받기 위해 태어난 사람
en: You were created to receive the greatest love
You now experience his never ceasing love
